features.name: delete the kiro prompts for pack skills
features.description: After feat-101 the 11 prompts in agents/kiro/prompts that name pack skills (apidog, audit, intake, jira, release, review, testing, and the retired shims plan-story, create-story-tasks, fetch-jira-story, jira-subtasks) are never installed. Owner decision 2026-10-23: delete them, no per-repo kiro prompts.
acceptance_criteria: agents/kiro/prompts holds only prompts whose skill is core
uninstall still removes old copies of the deleted prompts from ~/.kiro/prompts
features.evidence: Deleted the 11 pack prompts; agents/kiro/prompts keeps brainstorming, debug, experiment-iteration, tdd. Tests first: the retired-prompt checks for install and uninstall failed before RETIRED_KIRO_PROMPTS existed; all pass after. install.sh on this host left exactly those 4 in ~/.kiro/prompts. docs/migration.md updated. Two subagent reviews (correctness, security): no confirmed defects. Follow-up: drop RETIRED_KIRO_PROMPTS once every host has run install.sh, so a user prompt later named review.md or jira.md is not deleted. harness-verify all gates passed.
